items.title: Billie Pierce, De De Pierce, Israel Gorman, Joseph "Kid Twat" Butler Interview, 1963-11-20
items.q: Paul and I, Paul Barnes and I, we got a band, Sunset Syncopator

ctx.x: Cassie. The Young Tuxedo. The Young Tuxedo. Oh, I see. What are some of the other dance bands you played with?
Well, Paul and I, Paul Barnes and I, we got a band, Sunset Syncopator, and we've done a lot of work here, too. There's a lot of different, you know, outfits.
You've made some records with different people, too. Emile Barnes. Yeah, I mean, when we were born, yeah.
